intake.line: The Laminated Org Chart: Prava explains tenure, the faint hope of graduation and that he has been retained as a strong culture fit for Reconciliations; told for the first time that his forty-one years of pointless optimizing are an asset, Milo says yes before any choice is offered, and his loneliness turns into eagerness.

partition.line: Desk Neighbour: Milo is given a lanyard and the desk beside Zara Okafor, who trains him in terse instructions without looking up; his chatty questions meet flat answers he takes for friendship, and he leaves his first shift believing he has found a mentor and a place.

bell.line: Quota: Zara shows Milo how to review a restructured soul's remaining tenure, zero it out and file it under the department code the style guide will not spell out; he hits his quota in a day, then doubles it, and discovers he loves being good at this.

summons.line: Calendar Invitation: As the last line reconciles, a meeting request arrives from the office at the top: Quarterly Review, Mr. Voss, attendance mandatory; Zara reads it over his shoulder and tells him to bring the file.

corner office.line: The Corner Office: Milo enters the office no employee returns from unchanged and is reviewed by Edric Thane in long, formal sentences; the Lich praises his numbers, tells him he was once exactly such a clerk, and offers him the climb, and Milo sees his own future sitting across the desk.

discrepancy.line: Does Not Reconcile: Closing a routine restructured account, Milo finds the soul's tenure draining faster than any labor could explain; following the transfers, he sees every one of them flowing upward into a single pooled account at the top of the org chart, and his pleasure in the work stops.
